title: Interruption, isolation, then unstable recovery
description: Section A–B parts and the controller isolates. The section is repaired and the local reset button pressed. After reclose the repaired joint is intermittent: supply to B and C drops out twice (500 ms and 300 ms) before holding.
what_to_look_for: RESTORATION PENDING after the local reset (the dashboard does not and cannot reclose anything).
RECOVERY CHECK starts; each dropout sends the feeder back to INTERRUPTION SUSPECTED and resets the stability timer.
The same single event continues; its unstable-recovery count reaches 2.
Finally RESTORED and NORMAL after 10 s of continuous stable supply.

steps.note: Operator presses the LOCAL reset button on the controller
